commits.message:
decodeAnsi draws REP (CSI n b): the preceding graphic character n more times, to the margin (rich-control-codes-xh4n.m2d)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Every component's text is chosen and held on its own ground, disabled text tints on the ground it is on, and a removed role points at textOn wherever it is read (rich-palette-xovz.5rt)
Medium-review fixes: a stated role is drawn on its own ground, named walks nearest rungs first, TEXT_FITS is the one road to a fit (rich-palette-xovz.5rt)
Review fixes: one floor per intent, shades built only on a miss, cursor text on the cursor, removed roles point at textOn (rich-palette-xovz.5rt)

Theme text is drawn on its ground: textOn, with swappable fits, replaces the frozen text and on-* roles (rich-palette-xovz.5rt)

Textual's $text, $text-muted and $text-disabled are rules over the ground the
text sits on; rich-js froze them against `background`, so every consumer
painting another ground (cc-candybar's bar paints every ladder rung) rebuilt
text choice by hand. textOn(palette, intent, ground) now draws any of a
theme's text intents on any ground, held to WCAG floors as the terminal draws
the pair; text missing its floor goes to a TextFit — slide, named, tinted, or
the caller's own function. Widgets and the `textOn` template function draw
through it; a bare accent is not an intent.

Breaking: the on-*, text, text-muted and text-disabled palette roles are gone.
buildPalette now holds text-* at 4.5:1 on background, surface, panel and its
*-muted, and foreground-muted at 3:1 on the three grounds, for every theme.
The themes studio draws every bundled theme under each fit; docs/text-on.md.

decodeAnsi restores a saved cursor: ESC 7/8 and CSI s/u (rich-control-codes-xh4n.d9w) (#582)

* decodeAnsi restores a saved cursor: ESC 7/8 and CSI s/u bring back the column on its line, and the style and sets on any (rich-control-codes-xh4n.d9w)

* A restore is drawn statically only back to a save on its line; save and restore are two named groups; e2e and text docs follow (rich-control-codes-xh4n.d9w review)

* The docs gate reads what ends a line from the decoder (LINE_ENDS), C1 NEL and CNL included; save and restore handled once in the scan; DECLRMM noted (rich-control-codes-xh4n.d9w review)
